OPTION_A_EMBEDDED_WEB_OAUTH.name: Embedded Webview OAuth + Cookie Session
OPTION_A_EMBEDDED_WEB_OAUTH.rejection_reason: Google blocks embedded WebViews for OAuth 2.0 (RFC 8252 violation). Insecure cookie sharing across native/webview boundaries.

OPTION_B_SYSTEM_BROWSER_TICKET_EXCHANGE.name: System Browser / Custom Tab / ASWebAuthenticationSession + One-Time Ticket Exchange
OPTION_B_SYSTEM_BROWSER_TICKET_EXCHANGE.verdict: SELECTED. Full Ponytail-aligned reuse of existing SessionManager and single-use ticket exchange. Zero third-party SDK bloat. Maximum RFC 8252 compliance.

OPTION_C_NATIVE_GOOGLE_IDENTITY_SDK.name: Native Google Identity SDK (Credential Manager) Direct to Backend
OPTION_C_NATIVE_GOOGLE_IDENTITY_SDK.rejection_reason: Requires heavy platform-specific client credentials, Google Play Services dependencies on Android, separate Google Sign-In SDK on iOS, and custom backend token verification pathways.

OPTION_D_DEFER_AUTH.name: Defer Account Authentication Entirely
OPTION_D_DEFER_AUTH.rejection_reason: Backend already possesses 90% of the necessary auth infrastructure. Deferring leaves M16 milestone unfulfilled.

key_architectural_guarantees: Uses Android Custom Tabs / Chrome / system browser and iOS ASWebAuthenticationSession
Deep link callback delivers ONLY short-lived (60s), single-use burned exchange tickets (no session tokens or refresh tokens in URLs)
Native apps exchange ticket via POST /auth/session/exchange and store session token in Android Keystore / iOS Keychain
Zero Firebase, zero Auth0, zero Clerk, zero Supabase
